ФАЗА 2: EventQueue (primary)
input: EventDTO
output: queued
side_effects: NO (queue only)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ФАЗА 3: Drain Primary
input: queue
output: EventDTO[]
side_effects: YES (in-memory)
• MemoryProcessor.apply()
 → evaluate importance
 → evaluate emotion
 → evaluate relation
 → update NPCState
• StateApplicator.apply_physical()
 → урон, позиция, физика

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ФАЗА 4: TopicExtractor
input: NPCState (fresh)
output: str (topic)
side_effects: NO
Приоритет:
1. STM 2. L2 3. Keywords
4. last_topic (decay)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ФАЗА 5: DecisionHub
input: NPCState + topic
output: DecisionResult
side_effects: NO
→ CommunicationIntent

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

ФАЗА 6: IntentEventAdapter
input: CommunicationIntent
output: EventDTO
side_effects: NO
Lossy transform:
intent → EventType
exposure → visibility/radius

ФАЗА 8: Drain Secondary
input: queue
output: EventDTO[]
side_effects: YES (handlers)
• memory_manager.handle()
• social_engine.handle()
• scene_state_manager.handle()
• reaction_resolver.handle()
• StateApplicator.apply_psychological()

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ФАЗА 8.5: Meta Phase
input: финальное state
output: обновлённое state
side_effects: YES (in-memory)
• decay (затухание)
• resonance (паттерны)
• contradiction_resolver
Lifecycle hook. НЕ handler.

input: state (после Meta)
output: WorldSnapshotDTO
side_effects: NO
Reducer: events → state

YAML snapshot export
